sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.15 "EXTI external interrupt selection register (EXTI_EXTICR3)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 464.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x068
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
EXTI mux 8, 9, 10, 11
Bits 31:24 EXTI11[7:0]: EXTI11 GPIO port selection
These bits are written by software to select the source input for EXTI11 external interrupt.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV11 is disabled, EXTI11 can be accessed with privileged and
unprivileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV11 is enabled, EXTI11 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit is discarded.
